parameters.query:
WITH recent AS (
    SELECT
        c.incident_id,
        c.priority,
        c.status,
        c.opened_at,
        c.acknowledged_at,
        c.resolved_at,
        COALESCE(e.category, 'unknown') AS category
    FROM automation.incident_cases AS c
    LEFT JOIN automation.incident_events AS e
      ON e.event_id = c.source_event_id
    WHERE c.opened_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*)::integer AS total_incidents,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE priority = 'critical'
        )::integer AS critical_incidents,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE status = 'resolved'
        )::integer AS resolved_incidents,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE status <> 'resolved'
        )::integer AS unresolved_incidents,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE acknowledged_at IS NOT NULL
              AND acknowledged_at > opened_at
        )::integer AS acknowledged_incidents
    FROM recent
),
categories AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        COUNT(*)::integer AS incident_count
    FROM recent
    GROUP BY category
    ORDER BY incident_count DESC, category
    LIMIT 10
),
daily AS (
    SELECT
        opened_at::date AS incident_date,
        COUNT(*)::integer AS incident_count
    FROM recent
    GROUP BY opened_at::date
    ORDER BY incident_date
)
SELECT
    NOW() AS generated_at,
    '7 days' AS reporting_period,
    m.total_incidents,
    m.critical_incidents,
    m.resolved_incidents,
    m.unresolved_incidents,
    m.acknowledged_incidents,
    (
        SELECT COALESCE(
            jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'category', category,
                    'count', incident_count
                )
                ORDER BY incident_count DESC, category
            ),
            '[]'::jsonb
        )
        FROM categories
    ) AS categories,
    (
        SELECT COALESCE(
            jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'date', incident_date,
                    'count', incident_count
                )
                ORDER BY incident_date
            ),
            '[]'::jsonb
        )
        FROM daily
    ) AS daily_trend
FROM metrics AS m;
